tooltip.text:
• Players, after locking their kits in, battle over the middle zone
• Filling the middle ends the round, even if opponent is alive
• The player, who wins 3 rounds wins the duel

• Players equipped with Team Fight gamemode kits fight a best-of-5 match
• Players lose a life when they die
• The player, who loses all 3 lives loses the duel

• Players stand on opposite sides of the map, and are given a single arrow
• Players dies from a single arrow shot
• The player, who kills his opponent 3 times wins the duel

• Players race in an endless race of Parkour Knockout patterns
• Completing the series of 3 patterns makes your opponent start to lose health
• The player, who depletes his health first loses the duel

• The players' task is to score a goal in their enemy's base 5 times
• Falling into the void respawns you
• The player, who scores 5 goals first wins the duel
